entities.name: Kula
entities.description: A large anchorite and druid of Dominaria who could spot lies and joined a party of dragonslayers.

entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: Pixie who recruited Kula to kill the dragon enslaving his people.

entities.name: Donner Rus
entities.description: Party member who betrayed the group and died.

entities.name: Tania Cayce
entities.description: Party member who betrayed the group, was revived by Vaan, and killed the dragon.

entities.name: Mak Fawa
entities.description: The mechanical dragon that enslaved Vaan's people.

entities.name: Hand of Righteous Retribution
entities.description: Powerful magical sword Tania used to kill the dragon.

events.summary: Vaan asks Kula to help kill the dragon that enslaved his people and she joins.
events.quote: she agreed to join his party of dragonslayers

events.summary: Donner Rus and Tania Cayce betray the group; Donner dies and Tania is revived by Vaan.
events.quote: This cost Donner his life, but Tania was brought back by Vaan

events.summary: Tania kills the dragon with the Hand of Righteous Retribution.
events.quote: it was Tania who killed the beast with the Hand of Righteous Retribution

events.summary: Kula offers to train Tania as a druid; she declines.
events.quote: Kula offered to train Tania in the ways of the druids, but Tania decided to decline.

relations.quote: it was Tania who killed the beast
she agreed to join his party of dragonslayers
